title: Finite cofinal resolution with embedded nondegenerate simplices
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, ordinary nerves, quasicategories, functor simplicial sets, constant diagrams and right-pinched Kan mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], with universes enlarged as necessary. A finite simplicial set means one with finitely many nondegenerate simplices; a simplex is nondegenerate when it is not obtained by a nonidentity surjective simplex operator from a lower-dimensional simplex. A monomorphism means a simplicial map injective in every degree. For every finite simplicial set $X$ there exist a finite simplicial set $Q$ and a map $q:Q\to X$ such that every nondegenerate simplex $\Delta^n\to Q$ is a monomorphism and, for every quasicategory $\mathcal E$, map $p:X\to\mathcal E$ and vertex $T\in\mathcal E$, restriction itself induces an equivalence of Kan complexes
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(X,\mathcal E)}(p,\Delta_XT)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(Q,\mathcal E)}(pq,\Delta_QT).$$
The case $X=\varnothing$ is allowed with $Q=\varnothing$. No quasicategory hypothesis on $X$ or $Q$ and no colimit-existence assumption on $\mathcal E$ is made.

mathlib_searches.query: Every finite simplicial set has a cofinal finite resolution in which every nondegenerate simplex is an embedding
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: SSet.Finite.instIsFinitelyPresentable, Finite.exists_epi_from_isCardinalPresentable, finite subcomplexes and dimension bounds. None asserts a cofinal nonsingular resolution.

mathlib_searches.query: finite simplicial set cofinal nonsingular resolution embedded nondegenerate simplices
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concern SSet.N, nonDegenerate, degenerate and SSet.Finite.mk; no resolution theorem.
SSet.Finite and finiteness of degrees/subcomplexes/ranges and under epimorphisms, plus hasDimensionLT_of_finite; no cofinal resolution.

Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/Nonsingular.lean and NonsingularColimit.lean, plus PairingCore.lean. Read Nonsingular.lean:11-22,42-48 and NonsingularColimit.lean:13-23,38-84: definitions, inheritance, and ordinary colimit presentations; no existence of a finite cofinal nonsingular replacement.
